label: CHAMPIONS LEAGUE · MATCHDAY 5
headline: Isak double, Wirtz stunner in Bruges
sub: Isak 13' & 82', Wirtz 79'. Isak's 10th goal of the season, and Liverpool move up to 5th.
caption:
🔴 Club Brugge 0–3 Liverpool.

Alexander Isak scored twice, the second a solo chip, and Florian Wirtz scored from outside the box. That's 10 goals for Isak this season.

label: CHAMPIONS LEAGUE · MATCHDAY 5
headline: Three penalties, a red card, no win
sub: Suárez pen 33' & 80', Fernandes pen 48' & 50'. Tielemans sent off in stoppage time.
caption:
😩 Sporting 2–2 Man United.

Bruno Fernandes scored twice against his old club, but a goalkeeping error let Luis Suárez equalise and Youri Tielemans was sent off late. Mauricio Pochettino is still waiting for his first win.

How long until it clicks under Pochettino? 👇

headline: Roma end PSG's 12-game winning run

caption:
